name: @storytree/forest-layout
description: WHERE THE ISLANDS SIT (ADR-0537 D1): the chrome-free island packing both surfaces may consume — the dependency-ranked territory seeder, the hex growth floor and its moat, the round-robin grower, the derived inter-island gaps, and the trail routing over the result. Pure, browser-safe, deterministic: data-in → layout-out, no React, no DOM, no store, no node: imports. It lived inside apps/studio/src/components/TreeView.tsx until this package existed; the studio chrome it was tangled with — the render: building class, the ADR-0102 icon promotion — stayed behind the seam and is INJECTED, never imported here.
